items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: benefit of Caruso training but without ever knowing Mr. Caruso

ctx.x: Aw, bless your heart. I didn’t know any of that.

Yeah, because I was very much into learning about my embouchure, about how embouchure development is, and I had a buddy who, a close friend with this amazing range and I wanted to learn from him how he got it and he showed me the exercises from Carmine Caruso, ‘cause he studied with him for a long time. So I got, really, the benefit of Caruso training but without ever knowing Mr. Caruso.
